{{Quote|Xizor and Vader have a long-standing feud.|[[Tyber Zann]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>}}
The '''bombardment of Falleen''' was undertaken by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to stop the spread of a [[flesh-eating bacterium]].

==Prelude==
Sometime during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] established a [[bacteriological research outpost]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]], an accident happened in a laboratory, which resulted the infection of the civilian [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] population by a [[flesh-eating bacterium]].

==The orbital bombardment==
In 7 BBY, Darth Vader explored different weapon development projects, when he arrived to Falleen aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bolvan/Legends|Bolvan]] showed Vader some projections based on information salvaged from the laboratories: the bacterium threatened to devastate the whole planet in short time. The captain suggested the requisition of the ordnance from [[Project X271]] and incinerate the plague from orbit, but Vader disagreed, because he did not wish to wipe out the entire Falleen [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] ordered [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Hija/Legends|Hija]] to prepare for [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] and fire on the bacteriological research outpost and everything within 40 kilometers.

==Aftermath==
The orbital bombardment stopped the plague, but took the lives of 200,000 Falleen. The whole family of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of the [[House Sizhran]] was among the civilian casualties. Xizor planned vendetta against Vader and erased any clue that could connect him to the royal family.

==Behind the scenes==
The bombardment of Falleen was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Shadows of the Empire'' novel]] and expanded in the [[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook|related sourcebook]].
